name: Jaipur
shortDescription: Forts, palaces and bazaars in the Pink City.
description: Jaipur blends royal history with lively markets. Explore Amber Fort, the City Palace and the Hawa Mahal, then shop for textiles and jewellery.

name: Kerala Backwaters
shortDescription: Houseboats, tea hills and calm canals.
description: Cruise through palm-lined canals in Alleppey, walk through the tea gardens of Munnar and relax with an Ayurvedic massage.

name: Goa
shortDescription: Beaches, old churches and coastal food.
description: Goa offers golden beaches, Portuguese-era churches and fresh seafood. Choose between lively north Goa and quiet south Goa.

name: Leh Ladakh
shortDescription: High mountain passes, lakes and monasteries.
description: A high-altitude desert with blue lakes, ancient monasteries and some of the best road trips in the world.

name: Manali
shortDescription: Snow, river rafting and mountain cafes.
description: Manali is a base for trekking, paragliding and snow trips. Visit Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass and the Old Manali cafes.

name: Ooty and Coorg
shortDescription: Coffee estates and misty hill stations.
description: Slow down in the hills: coffee plantations, waterfalls and toy-train rides through cool, misty landscapes.

name: Bali
shortDescription: Temples, rice terraces and surf beaches.
description: The Island of the Gods has cliff temples, rice terraces in Ubud and beaches for surfing and sunsets.

name: Paris
shortDescription: Art, cafes and landmarks along the Seine.
description: See the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre, walk through Montmartre and enjoy a river cruise in the evening.
